name: Curtsy Lunge
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell at your chest.
Step one foot behind and across your body, as if curtsying, and lower until your front thigh is about parallel.
Push through your front foot to stand and bring the back foot back.
Complete your reps on one side or alternate legs, keeping your hips square.
